kpis.name: Living Wage Coverage Rate (% of direct workforce)
kpis.description: Track and report the percentage of direct employees receiving at or above the local living wage benchmark.
kpis.target: 100% of all direct and indirect employees within the reporting period.

kpis.name: Community Investment Spend (£ / % of pre-tax profit)
kpis.description: Report total community investment spend and as a percentage of pre-tax profit annually.
kpis.target: Minimum 1% of pre-tax profit directed to community economic development, with outcomes tracked and published.

kpis.name: Supply Chain Fair Pay Audit Completion Rate (%)
kpis.description: Report the percentage of tier-one suppliers completing a fair pay and labour conditions audit.
kpis.target: 100% of high-risk suppliers audited, with corrective action plans in place for all identified issues.

kpis.name: Sustainable Commodity Sourcing Rate (%)
kpis.description: Track the percentage of key agricultural commodities sourced from certified sustainable sources.
kpis.target: 100% for all priority commodities by the target date, with annual progress milestones published.

kpis.name: Food Waste Volume (tonnes) & Reduction Rate (%)
kpis.description: Report total food waste generated across operations in tonnes and as a year-on-year reduction percentage.
kpis.target: 50% absolute reduction from the baseline year by 2030.

kpis.name: Supplier Sustainability Training Participation (%)
kpis.description: Report the percentage of agricultural suppliers completing sustainability training or capacity-building programmes.
kpis.target: 80% of tier-one agricultural suppliers reached within the reporting period.

kpis.name: Total Recordable Incident Rate (TRIR)
kpis.description: Monitor and report workplace injury frequency annually.
kpis.target: TRIR below the industry benchmark with a minimum 10% year-on-year reduction, embedded in operational leadership scorecards.

kpis.name: Mental Health Programme Utilisation Rate (%)
kpis.description: Track employees actively engaging with mental health support and EAP services.
kpis.target: 70% workforce awareness and 40% active participation by end of fiscal year with quarterly reviews.

kpis.name: Healthcare Benefit Coverage Rate (%)
kpis.description: Report on employees with access to comprehensive health and wellness benefits.
kpis.target: 100% coverage across all employment levels, contract types, and geographies with no exceptions.

kpis.name: Average Training Hours per Employee per Year
kpis.description: Report average annual training and development hours per employee by gender and level.
kpis.target: Minimum 40 hours per employee per year with a year-on-year increase in investment per head.

kpis.name: Training Participation Rate (% of workforce)
kpis.description: Track the percentage of employees completing at least one formal learning activity in the reporting year.
kpis.target: 100% of all employees with an active development plan and at least one completed training.

kpis.name: Apprenticeship & Early Careers Intake (number / year)
kpis.description: Report the number of apprentices and graduates taken into the programme each year, with targets aligned to business growth. Track and report conversion to permanent employment rates.
kpis.target: Targets aligned to business growth.

kpis.name: Gender Pay Gap (% median & mean)
kpis.description: Measure and report median and mean gender pay gap annually by seniority band.
kpis.target: Eliminate all statistically significant gaps and publish full methodology and results in the annual ESG report.

kpis.name: Women in Leadership (% at each level)
kpis.description: Track women in senior management, director, and C-suite roles.
kpis.target: >=40% female representation at each level, with year-on-year progression milestones and public reporting.

kpis.name: Parental Leave Return & 12-Month Retention Rate (%)
kpis.description: Report employees returning and remaining following all forms of parental leave.
kpis.target: >=90% return rate and >=85% 12-month retention rate across all genders.

kpis.name: Water Consumption (m³) & Intensity Ratio
kpis.description: Report total water withdrawal by source and water intensity ratio (m³ per unit of revenue or production) annually.
kpis.target: 30% reduction in water intensity from the baseline year by 2030.

kpis.name: Percentage of Sites in High Water-Stress Areas with Plans (%)
kpis.description: Track the percentage of sites identified as operating in high water-stress areas that have a formal water stewardship plan in place.
kpis.target: 100% of high-risk sites with active plans.

kpis.name: Wastewater Recycled or Reused (%)
kpis.description: Report the percentage of total wastewater generated that is recycled or reused within operations.
kpis.target: Year-on-year improvement toward zero process wastewater discharge to the environment.

kpis.name: Renewable Energy Consumption (% of total)
kpis.description: Report the percentage of total energy consumption from renewable sources.
kpis.target: 60% by FY2026 and 100% by FY2030, reported with full GHG Protocol methodology including any REGos applied.

kpis.name: Total Energy Consumption (MWh) & Intensity Ratio
kpis.description: Report absolute energy consumption and energy intensity per unit of revenue or production.
kpis.target: 25% reduction in energy intensity from the baseline year by 2030.

kpis.name: Energy Cost Savings from Efficiency Measures (£)
kpis.description: Track and report cumulative energy cost savings achieved through efficiency investments. Report annually with breakdown of savings by site and technology type to demonstrate return on investment.

kpis.name: Average Training Hours per Employee per Year
kpis.description: Report average annual training hours per employee by gender and seniority.
kpis.target: Minimum 40 hours per employee per year, with a year-on-year increase in learning investment per head.

kpis.name: Living Wage Coverage Rate (% of direct workforce)
kpis.description: Track the percentage of direct employees at or above the local living wage benchmark.
kpis.target: 100% of the direct workforce, with annual milestones reported against the supplier extension roadmap.

kpis.name: Supply Chain Labour Rights Audit Completion Rate (%)
kpis.description: Report the percentage of high-risk tier-one suppliers completing independent labour rights audits.
kpis.target: 100% audited within the reporting period, with all corrective actions tracked to satisfactory resolution.

kpis.name: R&D Investment (£ / % of revenue) in Sustainable Innovation
kpis.description: Report total R&D investment and the proportion directed at sustainability-related innovation annually.
kpis.target: Year-on-year increase in sustainable R&D spend as a percentage of total revenue.

kpis.name: Digital Transformation Milestone Completion Rate (%)
kpis.description: Track the percentage of digital transformation milestones completed against the published roadmap each year. Report efficiency gains, cost savings, and sustainability outcomes achieved through digitisation.

kpis.name: Supply Chain Risk Concentration Index
kpis.description: Report the proportion of critical inputs sourced from a single supplier or geography.
kpis.target: Reduce single-source dependency for all identified critical inputs below a defined threshold within the reporting period.

kpis.name: Intersectional Pay Gap (% by demographic group)
kpis.description: Report median pay gaps by ethnicity, disability, gender, and other protected characteristics annually.
kpis.target: Eliminate statistically significant gaps across all groups within a defined timeframe.

kpis.name: Representation of Underrepresented Groups (% at each level)
kpis.description: Track and report the percentage of employees from defined underrepresented groups at each organisational level.
kpis.target: Report year-on-year progress against published representation targets.

kpis.name: Socioeconomic Diversity in Graduate & Apprentice Intake (%)
kpis.description: Report the socioeconomic background profile of graduate and apprentice entrants annually.
kpis.target: Year-on-year improvement in representation from lower socioeconomic backgrounds in early careers programmes.

kpis.name: % of Sites with Green Building Certification
kpis.description: Report the percentage of operational sites with a recognised green building certification (BREEAM, LEED, or equivalent).
kpis.target: 100% of new builds certified and a year-on-year improvement in existing site ratings.

kpis.name: Community Engagement Actions Resolved (%)
kpis.description: Track the number of community issues or concerns raised and the percentage resolved within agreed timeframes.
kpis.target: 100% of community issues logged and 90% resolved within 30 days of receipt.

kpis.name: Local Procurement Spend (% of total addressable spend)
kpis.description: Report local procurement spend as a percentage of total addressable spend annually.
kpis.target: 30% local procurement by a defined date with year-on-year improvement milestones published.

kpis.name: Total Waste Generated (tonnes) & Landfill Diversion Rate (%)
kpis.description: Report total waste generated by category and the percentage diverted from landfill annually.
kpis.target: 100% landfill diversion by 2030 with year-on-year waste generation reduction.

kpis.name: Recycled or Circular Materials as % of Total Input
kpis.description: Track the percentage of materials and inputs that are recycled, reused, or of certified sustainable origin.
kpis.target: Year-on-year increase toward a defined circular materials target.

kpis.name: Sustainable Procurement Coverage (% of total spend)
kpis.description: Report the percentage of total procurement spend covered by suppliers meeting the sustainable procurement policy criteria.
kpis.target: 100% of all new contracts and 80% of total spend by the target date.

kpis.name: Total GHG Emissions (tCO2e) — Scope 1, 2 & 3
kpis.description: Report absolute Scope 1, market-based Scope 2, and material Scope 3 emissions against a defined baseline year, with SBTi-aligned reduction milestones and full GHG Protocol methodology disclosed.
kpis.target: SBTi-aligned reduction milestones with full GHG Protocol methodology disclosed.

kpis.name: Renewable Energy Consumption (% of total)
kpis.description: Track the percentage of total energy from renewable sources.
kpis.target: 60% by FY2026 and 100% by FY2030, reported with full methodology including any EACs or REGos applied.

kpis.name: Carbon Intensity Ratio (tCO2e per GBPm revenue)
kpis.description: Report carbon intensity against revenue targeting a minimum annual reduction, demonstrating continuous efficiency improvement and decoupling of business growth from emissions growth.
kpis.target: Minimum annual reduction.

kpis.name: Single-Use Plastic Reduction (tonnes / % eliminated)
kpis.description: Report total single-use plastic eliminated from products and operations in tonnes and as a percentage of the baseline.
kpis.target: 100% elimination of identified single-use plastics by the target date.

kpis.name: Sites with Zero Plastic-to-Waterway Incidents (%)
kpis.description: Track the number of plastic pollution incidents affecting waterways from operational sites.
kpis.target: Zero incidents across all sites, with annual audit completion rates and corrective action resolution tracked.

kpis.name: Sustainable Marine Ingredient Sourcing Rate (%)
kpis.description: Report the percentage of material marine-derived ingredients sourced from certified sustainable sources.
kpis.target: 100% sustainable sourcing for all material marine ingredients by the target date.

kpis.name: Zero Deforestation Compliance Rate (% of priority commodities)
kpis.description: Report the percentage of priority land-use commodities sourced in compliance with the zero-deforestation commitment.
kpis.target: 100% traceable and verified compliance for all priority commodities by the target date.

kpis.name: Sites with Biodiversity Management Plans in Place (%)
kpis.description: Track the percentage of major operational sites with a current biodiversity impact assessment and management plan.
kpis.target: 100% of sites with measurable biodiversity targets by the target date.

kpis.name: Nature-Based Solutions Investment (£ / hectares restored)
kpis.description: Report total investment in verified nature-based solutions and the resulting area of habitat restored, protected, or enhanced.
kpis.target: Year-on-year increase in investment aligned to net positive nature commitment.

kpis.name: Anti-Bribery & Corruption Training Completion Rate (%)
kpis.description: Report the percentage of employees completing mandatory ABC training within the required annual cycle.
kpis.target: 100% completion rate for all employees and contractors with access to company resources or third-party relationships.

kpis.name: Ethics Hotline Reports Resolved Within 30 Days (%)
kpis.description: Track the number of reports received via the ethics hotline/speak-up channel and the percentage resolved within 30 business days.
kpis.target: 100% of substantiated reports receiving a documented resolution within the timeframe.

kpis.name: ESG Disclosure Assurance Coverage (% of material metrics)
kpis.description: Report the percentage of material ESG metrics receiving independent external assurance.
kpis.target: Year-on-year increase in assured metrics, with a defined target for full limited assurance on all material data.

kpis.name: Number of Active Industry SDG Partnerships
kpis.description: Report the number of active industry coalitions, multi-stakeholder initiatives, and partnerships contributing to SDG delivery.
kpis.target: Participation in at least three credible initiatives with documented contributions and outcomes each year.

kpis.name: ESG Reporting Standards Coverage & Assurance Level
kpis.description: Report the percentage of material sustainability metrics covered by GRI, SASB, and TCFD disclosures, and the level of independent external assurance obtained.
kpis.target: Full limited assurance on all material quantitative metrics.

kpis.name: Strategic Suppliers with Active Sustainability Improvement Plans (%)
kpis.description: Track the percentage of strategic suppliers with co-developed, active sustainability improvement plans.
kpis.target: 100% of strategic suppliers engaged in collaborative sustainability programmes with documented progress.
